name: 钩织玩偶定格
line: 毛线一针针钩出来的玩偶和满屏小世界，糖果色、热闹、到处都在轻轻动
line_en: Yarn dolls and a whole small world hooked stitch by stitch: candy colours, busy, everything gently moving

best.subject: Places full of small creatures edge to edge, like the seabed, a pond or a garden; treasure hunts, collecting, making friends, lively little adventures
best.palette: Candy colours: coral pink, lemon yellow, mint green, lavender; cyan-blue gradient background
best.light: Top light from above, bright and high-key, very light shadows
best.camera: Front-on at eye level, hero centred, framed on both sides by larger crocheted coral (symmetrical composition); medium shots also use front-left and front-right 40° setups; seaweed, bubbles and small fish are composited separately in front and back rows

good_for: Small creatures of the seabed, gardens, ponds
Making friends, a band of companions
bad_for: Stories needing crisp, hard-edged action (fights, machines)

music.desc: Undersea bubble band: vibraphone sings a pentatonic melody, kalimba answers, ukulele strums the offbeats, jazz pizzicato bass, congas and shaker with a little swing; key actions hit with a marimba gliss and slit drum, kalimba arpeggios as sparkle

voice.tone: Curious and bouncy, like a child leaning on a fish tank introducing you to the friends inside

transitions.name: Crochet blanket drop
transitions.how: A crocheted granny-square blanket drops over the lens from the top with a soft, slightly ragged edge, fills the frame for one drawing, then is lifted back up and away to reveal the next scene. Asset: generate with the texture type, [material] "a crocheted granny-square blanket: rows of small squares, each worked in rings of <this film's candy colours> with an off-white border, chunky stitches clearly visible, filling the whole frame" (use colours already in this film's set and characters), save as src/fx_smear_tex.png; the template's load() reads it automatically. In SHOTS write tr='blanket_drop'. A soft whoosh (pitch 0.8) as it drops, a puff as it lifts

transitions.name: Bubble curtain
transitions.how: A big mass of yarn bubbles surges up from the bottom of the frame and covers it (only where bubbles belong, i.e. underwater; anywhere else use blanket_drop); cut on the fully covered drawing, then the bubbles keep rising away to reveal the next scene. Asset: generate with the fx type "a big cluster of solid yarn bubbles surging upward (for a scene change), 8 stages: three or four rise from the bottom of the cell, more and more, almost filling the whole cell by cell 5, then scattering upward", animi.py slice src/fx_curtain.png work/cells fx_curtain --group grid, params.sprites take the densest fx_curtain_3 to _6, the template's load() reads them automatically. In SHOTS write tr='bubble_curtain', with whoosh plus bubble. Once per film, at a section boundary
